description: This file contains helper functions for parsing CPU affinity masks, including functions to parse individual CPU indices, CPU ranges, and to validate CPU indices, as well as a function to parse and set CPU affinity masks based on string input.

classes.name: interval<unsigned, true>
classes.description: A class representing a range of unsigned CPU cores with inclusive start and stop values.

methods.name: parse_int
methods.description: Template function to parse a string into an integer, returning an expected type with error handling.

methods.name: is_valid_cpu_index
methods.description: Validates if a CPU index is within available CPU IDs and returns an error message if invalid.

methods.name: parse_one_cpu
methods.description: Parses a string into a CPU index, validating the index.

methods.name: parse_cpu_range
methods.description: Parses a string representing a CPU range (e.g., '0-3') into an interval object.

methods.name: ocudu::parse_affinity_mask
methods.description: Parses a string of CPU affinities and sets the corresponding bits in a CPU affinity mask.
